name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 3px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast. It balances visibility for low-vision users with compatibility across color modes and reduced-motion settings. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings on high-DPI screens, but that’s preferable to thin rings disappearing on monochrome or dim displays.

name: Reader
text: A 3px ring at 4.5:1 still fails on monochrome displays where the ring blends into backgrounds. Use a 4px ring at 7:1 contrast—it remains visible on patterned and monochrome screens without relying on color alone. Test with grayscale and high-contrast mode to confirm.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast. It guarantees visibility on monochrome, patterned, and high-contrast mode screens where color alone fails. The trade-off is a slightly bolder ring on high-DPI displays, but that’s a worthwhile cost for universal keyboard navigation clarity.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring at 7:1 contrast risks making the UI feel heavy on mobile touch targets where space is tight. Test a 3px ring with a 7:1 contrast *and* a 1px solid outline fallback in grayscale mode—if it passes in both, it’s the leaner solution. Settle it with a quick prototype in high-contrast and monochrome modes.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Finalize 3px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with 1px outer glow (white) — deliver a tested, high-contrast focus style for EXCAVA and own it.
